name: SXM Demo
summary:
🎮 *Game Overview*: SXM Demo is a sneak peak to Stunt X Mania. Have you ever wondered if you could go crazy and perform insane motocross and stunts at home? We bring to you hyper-realistic bike controls like you've never experienced before! 

🏁 *Key Features*

- Enjoy a new hyper-realistic vehicle control system, with engaging clutch and gear mechanics and crazy jumps!

🕹️ *Game Modes*

- *Free Roam* -  No-holds barred, master your motocross bike skills without thinking of running out of time!

For 360 F
